propositions: Boundary/trailing whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason produce different material fingerprints and incorrectly return stale-material verdicts
material_basis() inserts no_file_impact_reason byte-for-byte raw when file_impact_scope is none, contrary to the canonicalization contract applied to description

Normalizing insignificant whitespace in no_file_impact_reason via normalize_reason parameter restores identical fingerprints for whitespace-only variants while preserving meaningful edits as material changes
Legacy material candidates for pre-330c and post-330c/pre-2be7 must explicitly disable reason normalization to preserve byte-exact historical fingerprint reproduction
Post-2be7/pre-fix attestations with canonical descriptions and raw reasons require a third legacy candidate with normalize_reason=False to avoid false staleness after the fix
